Definition: to test (especially metals); generally and figuratively, to investigate
BiblicalUsage: 1) to examine, try, prove; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to examine, scrutinise; 1a2) to test, prove, try (of gold, persons, the heart, man of God); 1b) (Niphal) to be tried, proved; 1c) (Pual) to make a trial
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
